dedupe_keys.name: artion first responder mobile phone traces and drone footage from cyprus civil defence exercises 2021 2022

description: These data sets record where rescue workers actually moved during four emergency exercises run by the Cyprus Civil Defence, together with drone video from two of them. The producers are the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence at the University of Cyprus, which collected the data in the European ARTION project with the Civil Defence. Coverage is a flood exercise at a lake in Achna in February 2021, a search-and-rescue exercise after a simulated tornado in the abandoned village of Vretsia in April 2021, a seaside search in February 2022 and a beach search near Mandria in May 2022, all in Cyprus. Each trace gives the GPS position of a phone carried by a first responder, about every second in 2021 and every five seconds in 2022; the drone files are raw video, and each deposit describes the exercise scenario, teams and casualties. The files are available as free downloads from Zenodo under Creative Commons Attribution or Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licences. Caveats: staged exercises, not real incidents, a few responders per event, and phone GPS error in buildings and rough terrain. Simulation uses: calibrating agent-based models of search and rescue movement, testing tracking and coordination tools, and training person detection on drone video. Related records: GAMA (platform-gama) and JuPedSim (model-jupedsim) can simulate responder and pedestrian movement.

name: ARTION first responder mobile phone traces and drone footage from Cyprus Civil Defence exercises (2021-2022)
provider: KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence (University of Cyprus), with the Cyprus Civil Defence, ARTION project
schema_summary: One trace per first responder: GPS positions from the phone's receiver about every 1 second (2021) or every 5 seconds (2022, 9 responders via the ARTION app); raw drone video files; exercise scenario descriptions

sources.note: KIOS CoE (University of Cyprus); CC BY-SA 4.0; published 2021-09-09; search-and-rescue exercise 11 April 2021 in the abandoned village of Vretsia, Paphos district: after a tornado seven campers missing; emergency operation centre, first aid station, drone centre, two rescue teams, a rescue dog and a drone; zip of traces

Flood exercise 21 February 2021 at an artificial lake in Achna (35.0556, 33.8122): water pumping, EOC and first aid station, search and rescue of three missing persons; organised by the Cyprus Civil Defence, data by KIOS; CSV traces from phone GPS about every 1 second; CC BY-SA 4.0
Search-and-rescue exercise 22 May 2022 near the beach at Mandria, Paphos; XLSX with 9 responders' traces captured by the ARTION mobile app about every 5 seconds; CC BY 4.0
Raw drone video (MP4) of a seaside search-and-rescue exercise on 13 February 2022 at Agios Georgios Pegeias near Paphos; CC BY 4.0
Search lists the traces and footage above plus 'Drones' footage of a flood exercise scenario' (5495992, CC BY-SA 4.0) and ARTION detector software records
